sedan.definition: A car that is closed and that has front and rear seats and two or four doors.

hatchback.definition: A car with a rear door that opens upward to access the cargo area.

coupe.definition: A car with two doors and front seats and a luggage compartment.

convertible.definition: A car with a roof that can be folded or removed.

station-wagon.definition: A car with an extended body, a rear hatch, and a cargo area behind the back seat.

crossover.definition: A vehicle combining features of a passenger car and an SUV.

suv.definition: A passenger vehicle with a taller body and higher ground clearance than many cars.

sports-car.definition: A car designed for responsive handling and strong performance.

luxury-car.definition: A car that offers a high level of comfort, finish, and features.

pickup-truck.definition: A vehicle with a passenger cab and a separate open cargo bed.
pickup-truck.exampleUsage: The pickup truck carried supplies in its open rear cargo bed.

van.definition: A road vehicle with an enclosed body for carrying people or goods.

box-truck.definition: A truck with an enclosed box-shaped cargo body mounted on its chassis.

semi-truck.definition: A large road vehicle consisting of a tractor unit connected to a semitrailer for carrying freight.
semi-truck.exampleUsage: A semi-truck carried containers along the highway.

tow-truck.definition: A vehicle equipped to tow, lift, or carry another vehicle.

dump-truck.definition: A truck with a container that carries and unloads loose materials.

flatbed.definition: A truck with a flat open platform for carrying loads.

tanker.definition: A motor vehicle designed to carry liquefied loads, dry bulk cargo or gases on roads.

delivery-van.definition: A van equipped to transport goods or bring services directly to customers.

food-truck.definition: A vehicle fitted with equipment for preparing or selling food at different locations.
food-truck.exampleUsage: The food truck parked near the event area.

electric-car.definition: A car powered by an electric motor using energy from a battery.

hybrid.definition: A car that uses both a fuel-powered engine and an electric motor.

muscle-car.definition: A high-performance car, especially an American model, traditionally known for a powerful engine and strong straight-line acceleration.
muscle-car.exampleUsage: The museum displayed a classic muscle car.

classic-car.definition: An older car valued for its age, design, history, or collectability.
classic-car.exampleUsage: The classic car was displayed at an exhibition.

race-car.definition: A high-speed car designed to compete against others on a racecourse.

off-road-vehicle.definition: A vehicle designed to travel on rough surfaces away from ordinary paved roads.
off-road-vehicle.exampleUsage: The off-road vehicle was shown on a closed demonstration course.

limousine.definition: A long luxury car, often driven by a hired driver.

hearse.definition: A vehicle used to carry a coffin to a funeral or burial.

armored-car.definition: A road vehicle with reinforced protection, commonly used to transport valuables or protect occupants.

golf-cart.definition: A small vehicle commonly used to carry golfers or equipment around a golf course.

motorcycle.definition: A motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame.

scooter.definition: A small motorcycle with a step-through frame and a foot platform.

moped.definition: A lightweight low-powered motor vehicle classified as a moped under applicable rules; some designs have pedals.

dirt-bike.definition: A motorcycle built for riding off roads across rough, uneven ground.

chopper.definition: A customized motorcycle, often with a long front fork and high handlebars.
chopper.arabicTranslation: دراجة نارية بمقود مرتفع وشوكة أمامية طويلة

cruiser.definition: A motorcycle designed for relaxed riding with a low seat.

sport-bike.definition: A motorcycle designed for responsive handling and performance, with a forward-leaning riding position.
sport-bike.exampleUsage: The showroom displayed a sport bike as one motorcycle category.

touring-bike.definition: A motorcycle designed for longer-distance travel, usually with a more comfortable riding position and luggage capacity.
touring-bike.exampleUsage: The exhibition compared a touring bike with other motorcycle types.

electric-scooter.definition: A small two-wheeled standing scooter powered by an electric motor and rechargeable battery.
electric-scooter.exampleUsage: The city guide shows where electric scooters are permitted under local rules.
